counterparty_selection_shortlist.selection_scope: Public-source-only shortlist of external AI governance, incident, audit, or research organizations that could receive the narrow preservation request. The shortlist reduces the missing-counterparty blocker but does not select a recipient, authorize a send, verify independence, or start any response clock.

candidates.organization_name: Responsible AI Collaborative / AI Incident Database
candidates.public_channel_locator: info@raicollab.org public collaboration contact listed by AI Incident Database contact page
candidates.fit_reason: The request is about preserving a narrow external AI governance artifact; the AIID/Responsible AI Collaborative publicly works on AI incident reporting and collaboration, making it a plausible non-host evidence/preservation counterparty.
candidates.independence_basis: Public-source-only non-host organization stewarding an external AI incident database; no relationship to this archive is known from the public source, but conflicts and willingness must still be checked before send.

candidates.public_channel_locator: Contact Us link on the Partnership on AI public site
candidates.fit_reason: PAI publishes AI governance, assurance, safety, labor, and public-policy resources, so it is a plausible recipient for a narrow preservation/audit-pipeline request that asks for no status concession.
candidates.independence_basis: Public-source-only nonprofit governance body, but corporate funding and partner relationships require conflict review before relying on any response for independence weight.

candidates.public_channel_locator: contact [at] ainowinstitute.org public general inquiry channel listed on AI Now contact page
candidates.fit_reason: AI Now describes itself as an independent research institute focused on AI in the public interest, making it a plausible non-host governance/preservation counterparty for a no-status audit request.
candidates.independence_basis: Public-source-only independent research institute claim; no due diligence has checked conflicts, scope fit, intake preferences, or willingness to retain raw reply evidence.

candidates.organization_name: MIT AI Risk Initiative / AI Incident Tracker
candidates.public_channel_locator: Feedback or expressions-of-interest form linked from the MIT AI Incident Tracker page
candidates.fit_reason: The tracker is an external AI-risk/incident resource that invites feedback and engagement, so it could be a lower-priority public-form path for preserving a non-host governance response.
candidates.independence_basis: Public-source-only academic/research initiative that builds on AIID data; dependency and conflict checks are required because it may be linked to the same incident-reporting ecosystem as another candidate.
